dial.summary: Real yields rising to 2.95% and DXY easing marginally to 102.02 keep macro headwinds stable but persistent — BTC.D holding firm at 58.5% with TOTAL crypto climbing to $2.95T and funding rates well below overheating at ~10% annualized confirm ongoing spot-led accumulation; September CPI (Oct 14) and FOMC (Oct 27–28) remain the dominant near-term catalysts.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: G4 M2 aggregate (Fed/ECB/BOJ/PBOC) at ~$103.6T based on August 2026 data (latest available, confirmed Oct 7); US M2 $23.3T as of August 2026 (up 5.7% YoY per macroradar.io); 3-month G4 change +1.17% (streetstats.finance); September G4 M2 not yet available (6–8 week reporting lag); 4-week trend flat: no confirmed September G4 data; YoY still meaningfully positive (not contracting); status neutral — confirmed rising 4-week trend required for supportive; ISM Prices at 77.9% and elevated CPI present a stagflation signal complicating the liquidity expansion narrative; next G4 M2 update expected mid-November 2026.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: September 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI = 54.5%, released October 1 (confirmed via ISM PR Newswire) — ninth consecutive month of manufacturing expansion; 4-week trend flat: August 54.6% → September 54.5% = −0.1pp, within the flat threshold; New Orders Index 55.3% (bullish forward signal); Production Index 56.7%; Prices Index 77.9% (highest since mid-2021, a leading CPI upside signal); status neutral (above 50 but flat; supportive requires above 50 AND rising on 4-week basis); next ISM Manufacturing release November 2, 2026.

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY at 102.02 on October 6, 2026 (down 0.14% from the Oct 5 close of 102.17); 4-week trend up: ~99.9 (Sep 5) → 102.02 (Oct 6) = +2.1% over 30 days, well above the 0.5% flat threshold; status headwind (above 100 threshold); DXY near 2-month high reflecting safe-haven demand and persistent USD structural bid driven by 10Y yield at 5.27%; a sustained close below 100 required to return to neutral status; October 14 CPI is the next major DXY repricing catalyst.

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: FRED DFII10 (10-year TIPS constant maturity) at 2.95% as of October 5, 2026 (latest Fed H.15 per watchgold.org/tradingview); up from 2.88% on October 1 and from ~2.50% on September 3; 4-week trend up: +45bps over 30 days; status headwind (rising 4-week trend AND above 2% absolute threshold both met); breakeven inflation ~2.28% (stagflation premium building with ISM Prices at 77.9%); a sustained fall below 2% required to shift status to neutral; October 14 CPI is the next key real yield repricing catalyst.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: October 6, 2026: 10Y Treasury at 5.27%, 2Y at 4.84% → 2s10s spread = +0.43% (+43bps); 4-week trend flat: Sep 3 spread ~+42bps → Oct 6 +43bps = +1bp over 30 days, within the flat threshold; status supportive (positive spread maintained); spread pulled back from Oct 5 peak of +47bps as 10Y fell from 5.31% to 5.27% while 2Y held steady; October 14 CPI and October 27–28 FOMC remain the next major yield curve catalysts.

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL: $6,743,031M ($6.74T) for week ending September 30, 2026 per Federal Reserve H.4.1 released October 1 (most recent; next H.4.1 release October 8 for week ending October 7); 4-week trend flat: Sep 2 $6,737,204M → Sep 30 $6,743,031M = +$5.8B marginal expansion within flat threshold on a $6.74T balance sheet; status supportive (holding at post-2022 stabilization plateau; no QT acceleration); weak September NFP (+29K) raises probability of a Fed hold at October 27–28 FOMC, supportive for balance sheet stability; October 8 H.4.1 will provide next data point.

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: BTC perpetual funding rate at approximately 0.0091% per 8h (~10% annualized per CoinGlass/CoinDesk), up from ~3% annualized in late September; open interest rose to 653,000 BTC ($56.2B) from 626,000 BTC on Sep 30 (CoinDesk Oct 2), signaling growing bullish leverage as BTC trades near $85K; 4-week trend up: rose from ~3% annualized (Sep early) to ~10% annualized (Oct early); status supportive (0.0091% per 8h is well below the 0.04% overheating threshold — confirmatory of spot-driven accumulation, not leveraged speculation); October 14 CPI and October 27–28 FOMC are next potential funding regime catalysts.

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$308B as of early October 2026 (CoinGecko/stablecoinbeat.com Oct 7); total crypto market cap ~$2.95T (up from $2.892T on Oct 5); BTC.D 58.5% (tv-hub.org Oct 2026); stablecoin dominance ~10.4% (308/2950); 30-day trend flat: ~10.4% (Sep 5) → 10.4% (Oct 7) = negligible change; status neutral (not falling on 30-day basis = not supportive; TOTAL rising but dominance not falling = headwind condition not met); USDT holds ~60% of stablecoin market (CoinGecko Sep 2026); ~$308B in sidelined capital available to deploy if macro improves; October 14 CPI is the next catalyst for stablecoin inflow/outflow dynamics.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended October 4, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET for the week ended October 4, 2026 — first claims reading fully capturing early-October labor conditions post the September NFP shock (+29K); prior weeks approximately 206K; consecutive claims above 225K would reinforce Fed hold expectations for October 27–28 and signal the NFP miss is a trend rather than a one-off.

upcoming.title: Fed Balance Sheet H.4.1 (week ended October 7, 2026)
upcoming.note: Federal Reserve H.4.1 release at 4:30 PM ET — weekly update to WALCL covering the week ending October 7, 2026; prior reading $6,743,031M ($6.74T, week ending Sep 30); this release will show whether the marginal expansion of the past 4 weeks continues or reverses; a shift toward contraction combined with rising overnight rates would flip balance sheet status from supportive to headwind.

upcoming.title: University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment (October 2026 Preliminary)
upcoming.note: University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment preliminary reading for October 2026 at 10:00 AM ET; September final was ~69.1; provides early read on consumer confidence heading into Q4; with DXY at 102.02, real yields at 2.95%, and the September NFP shock (+29K) fresh, a weak print below 65 would reinforce risk-off tone; 1-year and 5-year inflation expectations sub-components are closely watched by the Fed for second-round effects given ISM Prices at 77.9%.

upcoming.title: CPI (September 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS Consumer Price Index for September 2026 at 8:30 AM ET — the single most important data point before the October 27–28 FOMC meeting; August CPI YoY was +3.5%; ISM Manufacturing Prices Index at 77.9% (highest since mid-2021) is a significant leading signal for CPI upside; a hot print above +3.5% YoY could revive October hike odds and push DXY above 104; a dovish miss below +3.0% YoY would cement Fed hold expectations and likely catalyze DXY below 100 and a BTC breakout above $90K; real yields at 2.95% and DXY at 102.02 make this the dominant macro catalyst for October.
